correctness.rationale: For every q>=2 and r>=1, greedy embedding in P^omega uses one new period at each weak descent. At length r+1, each multiset has exactly one absent descending word per permutation, and the two sorts coincide iff its support is independent in the relative inversion graph. Stars-and-bars gives 2[binom(r+q,q-1)-sum_{j>=1}i_j(G)binom(r,j-1)]. Newton forward differences recover all i_j; the one-edge and complete inversion graphs attain and uniquely characterize the bounds. Direct independent scattered-subsequence checks covered 87 small parameter configurations and 8341 literal candidate strings.
